entry.title: Exploring Weight-Space Programming: Capabilities, Generalization, and Limitations
entry.summary:
Weight-Space Programming (WSP) enables reasoning agents to directly inspect and modify neural network parameters, offering an alternative to gradient-based model adaptation. However, its capabilities, cross-task generalization, and practical limitations remain insufficiently understood. We systematically investigate WSP through 16 editing trajectories across seven benchmarks and two model scales (Qwen3.5-0.8B and Qwen3.5-9B).

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #neuroscience #agents

entry.title: Bioprocess Modeling Made Easy With Hybrax
entry.summary:
Hybrid models that embed neural networks in ordinary differential equations are increasingly popular in bioprocess modeling, but they are challenging to set up. Much of the effort goes into the code around the model: wet-lab data must be imported and pre-processed, feeds and sampling must be accounted for in the balance equations, and a training loop with cross-validation must be set up. Researchers usually write this code from scratch for each project.

Source: bioRxiv Bioinformatics Preprints · Tags: #bioinformatics #genomics-proteins #neuroscience
